array_order: China RMB, US USD, except dimensionless rates
interpretation: Planning assumptions reproduce the existing workbook. Salary inputs are crowdsourced means captured in September 2026, not national or city medians. PPP is a rounded 2025 national household/NPISH consumption factor. Comparing it to this local basket does not isolate national measurement error.

assumption_notes.meals_and_replacements: Eight bought meals replace home cooking. Avoided ingredients, replacement lives, residual value, routine allowance and running costs are author budgeting assumptions, not measured household averages.
assumption_notes.housing: Owner scenario: 20% down, 30-year amortization. China 3.1% scenario; US 6.95% dated national benchmark. Property tax 0%/2.5%, insurance and repairs differ in basis and are not property-specific matched quotes. Principal is included in owner cash outflow.
assumption_notes.salary_snapshot: Chengdu source updated 2026-09-24; Houston 2026-09-22. Employee health-premium deduction treatment remains unresolved; both treatments are reported.
assumption_notes.model_dates: Core price inputs frozen 2026-09-24, numerical/PPP review 2026-09-27. Price evidence mixes dated 2025-26 offers and estimates; FX is the 2025 annual average, not current spot.
